en: Color postcard showing Sibiu's historic brick Stairway Passage with the Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral of St. Mary rising above it, featuring a tall spire with four corner turrets and clock faces. People walk through the vaulted passage. The reverse has Romanian handwriting dated 13 June 1983, a blue Romanian postage stamp marked "ARTA POPULARĂ / POSTA ROMÂNĂ" and a Bucharest transit postmark. Printed caption identifies the scene as the Stairway Passage in Sibiu; publisher Editura Meridiane and price are shown.
